# Vendored node-semver

Source: `semver@7.8.6` from the npm registry.
License: ISC (see `LICENSE`).

Only `index.js`, `classes/`, `functions/`, `internal/`, and `ranges/` are copied. `package.json` is replaced with a minimal CommonJS manifest so Node treats the files as CommonJS inside this ESM project.

Do not edit these files. To update, pack a newer `semver`, replace the copied directories, update the version in `package.json`, and rerun the test suite.
